algebra.recover: Re-run the same hop after fix. Never waive and proceed.
algebra.reports: Harness-generated only. Bound to this package_dir + input file hashes. Prerequisite reports need non-empty checks that match a live hop re-run (id+PASS stubs are REJECT). Forged, grafted, empty-check, or stale reports are REJECT. R3 re-scans current CV/CL/Brief/Profile HTML and independently re-verifies VI provenance; disk ACCEPT cannot waive those gates.

hops.name: Profile
hops.notes: Qualifying live evidence required: HTTP 2xx AND body contains company/slug marker. Local profile.html alone is REJECT. SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL. --fetch-profile 4xx/5xx/timeout/error is FAIL. Self-test may inject fetchResult.

hops.name: Closeout
hops.notes: ACCEPT means CV + CL + a real company Profile exist and match this package now, with qualifying live evidence (2xx + dedicated-profile path identity). Prior reports must be harness-generated, bound, fresh, and reproduce live hop evidence (not id+PASS stubs). R3 independently re-runs claim-lock, slop, skip-language, waiver, and R-VI provenance on current files.

profile_url.evidence: qualifying live HTTP 2xx whose body contains the company name and/or slug; local HTML alone is not enough; SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL
